data.one_liner: Context-free imperative navigation helper with built-in animations, dialogs, and deep link routing.
data.what_it_does: Provides an easy way to navigate in Flutter apps with context-free push and pop operations, built-in animated route transitions, dialogs, bottom sheets, and type-safe results. It supports deep linking via NavPathDelegate and can coexist with declarative routers like go_router.
use_when: You want context-free navigation without passing BuildContext everywhere.
You need custom animated route transitions or ripple effects easily.
You want a type-safe result-returning screen API.
avoid_when: You want a purely declarative navigation setup managed entirely by a modern router like go_router without imperative extensions.
strengths: Context-free navigation via a global navigator key or mixin.
Built-in route animations and ripple reveal effects.
Compatible with both basic Material Apps and Navigator 2.0 routers.
weaknesses: Imperative navigation style may not fit complex state-driven URL routing architectures.
data.setup_notes: Mix `Nav` into your app state or call `Nav.init(navigatorKey)` once, and configure deep linking intent filters on Android and Info.plist on iOS if needed.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official declarative routing solution with built-in URL-based navigation and deep linking support.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: Type-safe declarative routing with code generation for complex navigation structures.

alternatives.name: beamer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Delegate-based declarative routing that synchronizes your app state with the browser URL.
